class.name: SVG2D
class.brief_description: Renders SVG markup in a 2D scene.
class.description: SVG2D rasterizes SVG markup when its requested size changes, then reuses the generated texture.

method.name: get_texture
method.description: Returns the texture rasterized from [member src] at [member size].

members.member: The rasterized image size in pixels. Set both components above zero to override the SVG document size. [code]Vector2.ZERO[/code] uses the document size.
The complete SVG markup to render. Load an SVG file as text and assign its contents here.
